courseEvidence.description2: You will learn how to function in a ‘real-world’ design and development team for consumer products. comparability: Python and C++/Haskell implementation, algorithms, networks and operating systems, relational database methods, logic, calculus and statistics sustain the primary response. The second retains the technical core and extends mathematical modeling, transforms and autonomous motion through linear systems, calculus and robotics. The fourth different course supports a genuine human-context distinction through cognition and methods, with no interaction design promised. Physical prototyping, rhetorical argument and moral philosophy are complements within the first option. Bibliographic and experimental work throughout does not imply a dedicated 15 EC CS project.

stoppingDecision.assessment: Both options offer substantial programming, algorithms, systems and mathematics. The second option uses advanced mathematics and robotics to give intelligent systems a different focus. The available courses do not support a third specialist sequence in security or bioinformatics, or subject didactics and classroom practice in computing. The software option already addresses advanced programming.
